primary.description: Warm golden brown, representing baked crust and warmth.

client_app.structure: Mobile-first view. Fixed top header (glassmorphism), scrollable main content with ample bottom padding (pb-24), sticky bottom navigation.
client_app.product_card: Flex column, image takes top 60%, content 40%. Absolute positioning for 'Add' button overlapping the image bottom edge.
client_app.bottom_nav: Fixed bottom-0 left-0 w-full h-16 bg-white border-t border-stone-200 flex justify-around items-center z-50 pb-safe

admin_dashboard.structure: Responsive dashboard. Hidden sidebar on mobile (hamburger menu), visible on desktop. Topbar for quick actions and profile.
admin_dashboard.order_board: flex overflow-x-auto gap-4 pb-4 snap-x (Kanban style columns for order statuses)
admin_dashboard.density: Tight padding (p-4), strictly functional and high-contrast.

components.buttons: Always pill-shaped (rounded-full). Primary uses bg-amber-600 text-white. Secondary uses bg-stone-100 text-stone-800.
components.inputs: Shadcn based. rounded-xl, border-stone-200, focus:ring-2 focus:ring-amber-500/20 focus:border-amber-500.
components.cards: Cardless or Neumorphism soft. Do not overuse standard Shadcn cards. Use raw divs with rounded-3xl and soft shadows.
components.toasts: Use Sonner for all order notifications and state changes (top-center for mobile, bottom-right for desktop).
components.badges: rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider

responsive.breakpoint: Mobile-first. Base classes apply to mobile. Use sm:, md:, lg: for larger screens.
responsive.layout: Client app: 1-col -> 2-col -> 3-col on large screens. Admin: Stacked cards -> Grid -> Sidebar layout.
responsive.typography: Use fluid typography or standard Tailwind scales. H1 shouldn't exceed text-5xl on mobile.
responsive.overflow_guard: Ensure max-w-[100vw] overflow-x-hidden on root container. Use flex-shrink-0 for scrolling rows.
responsive.tap_targets: All interactive elements MUST have a minimum height/width of 44px (h-11 or p-3) for mobile touch accessibility.

hero_storefront.description: Warm bakery storefront display, use for login/welcome screen background.

product_bread.description: Fresh artisan bread, use for featured product or bread category.

product_pastry.description: Flaky pastries with coffee, use for pastry category or combo deals.

product_coffee.description: Coffee and croissants, use for breakfast offers or coffee category.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Build the client side strictly mobile-first. The user will view the 'Padaria do Brunao' app mostly on phones. Ensure the bottom nav is always visible and content doesn't get hidden behind it (add padding-bottom to main).
CRITICAL: The Admin Dashboard must be a separate route (e.g., /admin) and optimized for tablet/desktop, though still responsive.
CRITICAL: Include `data-testid` attributes on all buttons, links, inputs, and key elements (e.g., data-testid='add-to-cart-btn', data-testid='order-status-badge').
CRITICAL: Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for floating headers, dropdowns, or bottom navs. Always use solid colors or glassmorphism (backdrop-blur + high opacity bg).
CRITICAL: Use Lucide React for icons. Ensure icons in the bottom nav are clear and change color/weight when active.
CRITICAL: For real-time simulation, use React state and setTimeout/setInterval to demonstrate order status changes in the dashboard.
Do not use generic 'Inter' for headings. Use 'Playfair Display' for an artisan bakery feel, and 'Manrope' for body text.
Ensure contrast ratios are met. Dark text on light backgrounds. Do not use low-contrast grays for important information.
Use generous padding (p-4 to p-6) inside cards. Let the design breathe.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Make creative, distinctive frontends.
Do not use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is FORBIDDEN).
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped) with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭) for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, active scales).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
